question: Which comedy superstar just lost a fight to keep his lawsuit private?
story: A judge just refused to let Kevin Hart's company drag a lawsuit against two fired employees behind closed doors. According to theGrio and TMZ, a Los Angeles judge denied Hartbeat's motion to force the case into private arbitration on August sixth, ruling that the arbitration clauses in those employment contracts were unconscionable and could not be enforced. So it stays in open court. Here is what they are actually fighting about. Hartbeat reportedly sued former staffers Eric Eddings and Lesley Gwam, alleging they accessed confidential financial data and business plans for the audio division while building a competing venture, including an investor pitch deck seeking two million dollars. Both were let go on January thirtieth. Eddings and Gwam reportedly deny all of it, saying the deck used standard industry information and their own experience from before Hartbeat. A judge already tossed the company's injunction request once. Now it plays out in public.
